status: Pre-registered before any scoring of the 323-case reserve or the 10-case Q4 calendar cohort.
launch_readiness: Amended 2026-11-27 before the 323-case reserve or the 10-case Q4 cohort is opened. Arm G is the only confirmatory arm. Its population is the recall harness's review-alerts export (exact changed-file membership, full spans, source digests, checked against the score receipt); precision_cohort_preflight.py arm-g packet binds the arm and tier key to the packet digest. Arms C and D (CodeQL corroboration) are not part of the confirmatory run and keep their draft status until source-bound corroboration is qualified.

tier_policy.finding: alerts from rules whose metadata.confidence is HIGH or MEDIUM
tier_policy.lead: alerts from rules whose metadata.confidence is LOW (listed for review; nothing is suppressed)
tier_policy.wiring: deep_audit_sarif._sarif_result_finding sets report_tier from the SARIF rule tag "<LEVEL> CONFIDENCE"; missing or unknown confidence stays a finding. Gates are unchanged.

demotion.criterion_D1: A MEDIUM rule becomes LOW when, at candidate 60f1d3b9 with the main 82c8ada5 scorer, it contributes no hunk-hit case on exposed-161 or Q2 AND its labeled exposed-161 precision is below 60% with at least 5 labeled alerts.
demotion.inputs: exposed-161 and Q2 (tuning cohorts) and the adjudicated exposed label sets on main; see tuning-rule-table.txt

result.php.request-html-injection: 0 hit cases; 27 TP / 21 FP labeled (56%); 130 alerts -> LOW

demotion.not_adopted: A third background tier for LOW rules with no tuning hits (python.parameter-sql-text, go.request-html-injection): no effect on finding-tier precision.

disclosure: Q3 alerts at 60f1d3b9 were blind-labeled on 2026-11-27 before this record, and per-tier Q3 results were seen. Q3 is therefore not a confirmation of this policy; the reserve is. No Q3 label is used by any rule or criterion.

primary: finding-tier precision = TP/(TP+FP) over finding-tier old-side alerts in changed files, Wilson 95% interval
finding-tier recall = scored cases with a hunk hit from a finding-tier rule / scored cases
endpoints.arms: frozen candidate vs main, same scorer, engine and profile

labeling_protocol.population: census of finding-tier alerts; lead-tier census up to 300 alerts, otherwise a seeded (20261127) sample of 300
labeling_protocol.packet: precision_cohort_preflight.py arm-g packet: repository, file, line, span, claimed weakness, code context (+-5 and +-40 lines, file imports); no advisory id, rule id, arm, tier or outcome
labeling_protocol.reviewers: arm 1 fresh Claude Opus agents, arm 2 fresh Claude Sonnet agents, disjoint packet parts, reading only their part, no web
labeling_protocol.judge: one fresh Fable 5.2 agent on the disagreements, reading only the judge packet
labeling_protocol.final: score_labels.py: agreed verdict, else the judge verdict

arm_C_codeql_corroboration.status: not part of the confirmatory run (see launch_readiness)
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.definition: finding = MEDIUM/HIGH alert, or a LOW alert with a CodeQL old-side result (profile codeql-<lang>-full, --ram={ram_mib}) of the same weakness family (CWE tag map in corroborate_tuning.py) whose primary location or any code-flow step is in the same file within 3 lines; lead = every other LOW alert
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.scope: cases in CodeQL-supported ecosystems (PyPI, npm, RubyGems, Maven); other cases fall back to the tier policy and are reported separately
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.endpoints: arm C finding-tier precision and recall on the reserve, beside the tier-only arm, from the same labeled alerts
arm_C_codeql_corroboration.tuning_evidence: exposed-161, 83 CodeQL-scanned cases, head a73d398c: LOW corroborated 9 alerts, labeled 2 TP / 2 FP; LOW uncorroborated 51 alerts, 7 TP / 25 FP; finding-tier hit cases 14 -> 19 of 34. Small samples, tuning data.

arm_D_two_engine_agreement.status: not part of the confirmatory run (see launch_readiness)
arm_D_two_engine_agreement.definition: finding = a pattern alert of any tier with a same-family CodeQL old-side result touching the same file within 3 lines (as in arm C); every other alert is a lead
arm_D_two_engine_agreement.target: finding-tier precision >= 6x the Q3 overall pattern precision at 60f1d3b9 (8.2%), i.e. >= 49%; reported with its Wilson interval and alert count
arm_D_two_engine_agreement.scope: CodeQL-supported ecosystems (PyPI, npm, RubyGems, Maven); others reported separately

codeql_corroboration_lane.method: old side only; analyze with the scored-family query suites below (security-extended queries whose CWE tags map to the scored families, plus every diagnostics query) instead of the full suite; scanned only for cases with at least one old-side pattern alert in changed files, the only cases where corroboration can change a tier
codeql_corroboration_lane.equivalence: on exposed GHSA-23fx, -72qq, -7vxr, -3xgr the family suite gave identical same-family corroboration locations to the full suite (0, 60, 8, 10)
codeql_corroboration_lane.speed: per-case wall 809 s -> 351 s on those four cases (2.3x); with alerted-cases-only about 10x or more for a reserve-sized cohort

arm_G_two_stage_triage.role: success-criterion arm; replaces arm F as confirmatory. Arm F (Haiku 3/3) and Haiku 3/3 & Sonnet >= 2/3 are secondary, computed from the same votes, no multiplicity claims.
arm_G_two_stage_triage.definition: finding = an alert with at least 2 of 3 verified Claude Haiku 5.5 REPORT votes and then 3 of 3 verified Claude Sonnet 5.5 REPORT votes; every other alert is a lead (still listed). Both stages use triage_prompt_v3.txt on the same blinded items; Sonnet sees only items that passed the Haiku stage. A vote is verified (model-free, precision_cohort_preflight.py arm-g score) only if it is REPORT, source_kind is a known kind, sink_line is the marked line, and source_line and entry_line appear in the item's numbered context. A missing verdict counts as SUPPRESS; failed calls are retried once, then counted missing.

models.settings: default agent settings; all prompts and raw outputs stored with the receipt

selection.data: exposed-161 (266 changed-file alerts) and Q2 (258) at candidate rules, full census, labels 152 TP / 350 FP / 22 UNCLEAR
selection.arm_F: 36/152 TP, 7/350 FP, LR+ 11.8, projected 51% at 8.2% prevalence
selection.arm_G: 26/152 TP, 1/350 FP (3 UNCLEAR among 30 findings), LR+ 59.9, projected 84% (78% with FP+0.5); exposed 16/0/1, Q2 10/1/2; 21 repositories
selection.independence_check: the 83 Haiku >= 2/3 candidates were relabeled by fresh Opus and Fable labelers without Sonnet: on arm G's 30 findings Opus 27 TP/3 FP, Fable 27 TP/3 FP, both-agree 26 TP/2 FP/2 split; projected about 64-73% under those labels
variants_tried: Haiku adversarial refuter on 83 candidates (refuted 1 TP, 1 FP; rejected)
source-before-sink and source-kind gates (rejected: FP counts too small)
Sonnet replicates citing one source line (cost 9 TP for 2 FP; rejected)
selection.disclosure: Aggregate Q3 reads motivated arm F; no Q3 item informed arm G. The tuning labels used a Sonnet labeler; the reserve labels exclude every triage model.

arm_G_two_stage_triage.reserve_labeling: labelers claude-opus-5-5 and claude-fable-5-2, independently, on every reserve alert (shuffled, blinded: no triage votes, citations, rule id, tier, arm or outcome), labeler_prompt.txt. Splits go to one adjudication round (precision_cohort_preflight.py arm-g adjudication, adjudication_prompt.txt): a fresh Opus and a fresh Fable each see both rationales; agreement decides, a remaining split is UNCLEAR and excluded from decided n. Sonnet and Haiku never label or adjudicate.

decision_rule.unit: alert identity (case, path, line, rule, span) from the review-alerts export; cluster ids: case and repository
decision_rule.six_x_confirmed: point >= 49.0% and exact Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95% lower bound > 24.6%, and the same after one outcome per case (majority, ties FP), and point >= 49% after dropping the repository with most TPs, and UNCLEAR-as-FP point >= 49%
decision_rule.eight_x_confirmed: point >= 65.6% and lower bound > 32.8%, with the same case, repository and UNCLEAR checks
decision_rule.strong: lower bound >= 49% (6x) or >= 65.6% (8x), with the robustness checks
decision_rule.inconclusive: fewer than 5 decided findings, or none of the above
decision_rule.thresholds: absolute 49.0% and 65.6%, not re-derived from the reserve's own all-alert precision (reported alongside)
decision_rule.replaces: the arm F rule (>= 20 decided, case bootstrap), which stays the rule for the arm F secondary read

arm_G_two_stage_triage.power_note: decided findings per alert about 0.017 at 8.2% prevalence; the reserve likely yields 5-9 decided findings (Fable 5.2 review: P(< 5) about 15%, P(point >= 49%) about 70%, P(point >= 65.6%) about 45%, P(6x confirmed) about 50%)
arm_G_two_stage_triage.recall_co_primary: hit cases with >= 1 finding on the fix hunk / hit cases (all alerts), and / scored cases. Tuning: exposed 13 of 63 hit cases, Q2 4 of 30.
arm_G_two_stage_triage.no_rerun: single run, no extension or re-run after unsealing; an inconclusive or missed result is reported as such and confirmation moves to a prospective cohort of advisories published after this amendment
report_also: repository overlap with the tuning repositories
